content.text: {"id": "mm7314a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "As of December 31, 2022, a total of 20 state Medicaid programs provided comprehensive coverage (all nine treatments)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "duration limits (39 states; 76%)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "only three states (Kentucky, Missouri, and Wisconsin) provided barrier-free coverage"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 15 in 2018 to 20 in 2022"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "falls short of the Healthy People 2030 target of all 50 states and DC"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the number of states with a treatment access barrier decreased for all seven barriers"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "falls short of the Healthy People 2030 target of all 50 states and DC"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Summary statistics were generated and compared with data previously reported through December 31, 2018"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Barrier-free coverage was defined as having none of the seven assessed treatment access barriers"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Information provided by state personnel was considered accurate."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "A barrier was considered to be in place if it existed for any of the nine assessed cessation treatments."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types"]}
